rounds.text: Refex Industries Ltd trades at an attractive P/E of 14.4x [E1], which is notably lower than its sector benchmark P/E of 16.55x [E6], offering a compelling valuation entry point given that the rules-based screen scores the business 89 out of 100 with a high confidence buy rating [E65]. The company demonstrates stellar compounding power, having delivered 43% compounded profit growth over five years [E19] and a 58% surge in profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E21], alongside expanding operating margins that rose by 7 percentage points over three years to reach 18% in the TTM [E30]. Return profiles are robust and comfortably exceed sector benchmarks, with a ROCE of 20.96% compared to the sector median of 13.7% [E10] and a median return on equity of 24% over the last ten years [E26]. Furthermore, the intrinsic value derived from a discounted cash flow model suggests massive mispricing against the current market price of ₹ 303 [E45], backed by a reverse DCF implying that the market only prices in a modest 3.8% earnings growth compared to the 18% base case [E47]. Promoter confidence is evident as their holding increased by 3.24 percentage points to 56.57% [E41], while broader macro conditions are supported by a strong utilities sector tailwind score of +0.93 [E73]. Conceded: promoters have pledged 43.5% of their holding [E62], debtor days have increased to 132 days [E63], and the one-year share price return stands at -30% [E25].
